quarantine.text: Three ways to get visual assets: (3) Asset libraries, packs and models artists have already made (Kenney, Poly Haven, itch.io); Library assets (Kenney Tiny Dungeon, Poly Haven, Quaternius).
quarantine.reason: Contradicts brief L55 'Do not use pre-made assets'; the strict reading is the only one that cannot fail the assignment.
quarantine.replacement: Invariant: every shipped asset is AI-generated or code-made and has a provenance-log row; no library pack is used unless the organisers rule otherwise in writing.

quarantine.text: Sky Roadster demo: Art 'Library models + code-built scenery'; SFX 'Recorded vehicle and air sounds'.
quarantine.reason: The demo shows library models and recorded SFX, which the brief bans; it is an example, not an allowance.
quarantine.replacement: Do not copy the demo's asset route; code-built scenery and synthesised/generated audio only.

quarantine.text: Vercel Hobby is non-commercial, 300 s function cap and no shared state across instances; host the static client there at most.
quarantine.reason: Current Vercel docs say WebSockets are available on all plans (functions can serve WS, 300 s cap), so 'holds no sockets' is outdated; non-commercial and 300 s parts stand.
quarantine.replacement: Vercel is fine for the static client; if used for sockets, reconnect before the 300 s cap and keep room state outside the function.

quarantine.text: Hosted PartyKit shut down on 23 Oct 2026; successor is PartyServer on your own Cloudflare.
quarantine.reason: The shutdown is upheld, not refuted, so the fact is kept; any lead that treats hosted PartyKit as a hosting option is rejected.
quarantine.replacement: Hosted PartyKit is excluded; PartyServer on our own Cloudflare account or a ws/Colyseus Node server are the candidates.

quarantine.text: Better: Colyseus or a small ws Node server on Render free (750 h/mo, 15 min idle sleep, about 1 min cold start).
quarantine.reason: Recommended as 'better' without the judging-morning cold-start, lost in-memory rooms or memory limits.
quarantine.replacement: Render free only with a pre-warm before judging, room caps, a heartbeat and restart-safe rooms.

quarantine.text: PeerJS is a no-server fallback; NAT reliability unverified.
quarantine.reason: Peer-to-peer may fail on judge networks and peerjs is stale (2025-06); no TURN plan.
quarantine.replacement: Server-relayed WebSocket is the only transport; no P2P without a tested TURN.

quarantine.text: Blender MCP: MIT, about 33k stars; can import Poly Haven/Sketchfab assets.
quarantine.reason: Unauthenticated socket that runs arbitrary Python; star count is not vetting; import path breaches the no-premade rule.
quarantine.replacement: Headless reviewed bpy scripts preferred; MCP only with safe mode, localhost, pinned commit and import tools off.

quarantine.text: Final Frontier ... with Kepler and restricted n-body physics.
quarantine.reason: Two physics models named with no body count, step or error budget; Kepler is closed-form only for two bodies.
quarantine.replacement: One simulated model: server-authoritative restricted n-body, fixed step, stated body count and error budget; Kepler only seeds/draws orbits.
